name: Unsora
description: Official hosted MCP server for Unsora, an AI content generation and social media scheduling app: generate images, video (Kling, Veo 3.1, Sora 2, Seedance 2.0 and other models), talking-avatar video, music, voiceovers, voice clones and thumbnails; upscale images and video; clip long videos into short clips; and schedule or publish posts with analytics to connected YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Threads and Pinterest accounts. Requires a paid Unsora plan (3-day free trial).
author: Shipped Studio
